explication: DeTi*k*Zify is a multimodal model and application for turning scientific figures or sketches into semantics-preserving TikZ programs. The main user workflow runs through the web UI, which invokes sampling or MCTS inference; generated code is compiled and rasterized, and MCTS can refine and rank candidate outputs using image similarity. The repository also includes model versions and adapters, dataset loaders, training, and evaluation metrics. Edges reflect README statements or the supplied source index and excerpts; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
